**Finding submitted: deviation (critical, ip-data).**

- **Issue:** Article III (p0048) gives Licensor all right, title and interest in the Licensed Technology and all IP therein, with no carve-out for us. Combined with the very broad "DERIVATIVE WORK" definition (p0005) and the paid-for customization/front-end development work under Article VII(b) (p0087), deliverables we commission and fund become Licensor property with only the narrow, terminable Field-of-Use licence and no licence-back. The Agreement is also silent on ownership of our trading, order and client data, and both "Intellectual Property Rights" and "Confidential Information" are drafted one-way in Licensor's favour.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** a single new paragraph after Article III confirming (a) we retain all rights in Licensee Data and our pre-existing IP with no assignment to Licensor, (b) we own customization deliverables we pay for (Licensor assigns), (c) a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to any Licensor IP embedded in those deliverables, and (d) no joint ownership. Licensor's platform ownership is left intact.
